messages:
Maya (support): Customer CS-4321 seeing intermittent 502s on hosted inference EU region since ~09:32 UTC. Mostly on streaming endpoints, short bursts. sample trace: trace=01a2b3c4.

Maya (support): Sample curl that failed for them:
```bash
curl -v -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -X POST https://api.hosted.redwood.ai/v1/stream -d '{"prompt":"hello","stream":true}'
```

Rafael (eng): Can you paste the X-Request-Id / trace header and an example response body? Also which model route?

Maya (support): trace header above, model=redwood-small-stream, response was just HTTP/2 502 with no body. Customer reports it happens after ~10-30s in-flight.

Priya (sre): Observed a spike in ingress.pipeline.short_circuit and ingress.upstream.read_timeout on frontdoor.euw1 at 09:31-09:34. Correlates with auth-proxy latency increase towards billing-ms. Snippet from frontdoor logs:
```
[09:32:14] frontdoor.euw1 trace=01a2b3c4 route=/v1/stream status=502 reason=short_circuit detail="upstream read timeout to auth-proxy (10.5.3.12:443)"
[09:32:15] auth-proxy 10.5.3.12 -> 10.6.1.8:443 backend latency=2.8s error=read_timeout
```

Rafael (eng): Sounds like the ingress runtime is short-circuiting once it can't get a quick auth/billing verdict and it's taking down the stream rather than buffering. Could be keepalive pool exhaustion + slow auth responses under streaming traffic.

Rafael (eng): Quick repro for us: stream a large prompt and artificially slow auth response. Example (local):
```bash
# start a slow auth stub returning 200 after 5s
python slow_auth_stub.py --delay 5 &
# then run a streaming client
curl -N -H 'Authorization: Bearer slowstub' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -X POST https://api-hosted-euw1.redwood.ai/v1/stream -d @large_payload.json
```

Maya (support): I was able to reproduce with curl -N plus --limit-rate to simulate slow client. 502 shows up when auth takes >3s and there are >8 concurrent streams on the same frontdoor instance.

Priya (sre): Immediate mitigation applied: increased upstream timeout to auth-proxy for euw1, bumped auth-proxy instance count + expanded keepalive pool, and enabled a short retry policy on frontdoor for auth failures. Rolling restart of affected frontdoor shards scheduled. Monitoring dashboards updated. @oncall please watch ingress.pipeline.short_circuit and auth-proxy p95.

deploy-bot: Rollout: frontdoor config change (auth-timeout=6s, retry=1) scheduled to euw1 at 09:45 UTC. Change id: cfg-2026-045.

Maya (support): Customer notified of mitigation and asked to retry; will keep ticket open until we confirm stability. Thanks all :thumbsup: :eyes:
